Prices & hours: the café opens at 9 a.m. and closes at 5 p.m. Tom & Jerry's Bakery is next door.

“Best flat white in town,” says one review — another calls it ‘overpriced’. A single espresso is €3.20 and a slice of cake is £4.50; the tip jar says 5–10% is customary.

Curly quotes: “straight” and ‘single’ ones, plus a non-breaking space between 10 and km, and &lt; stays &lt;. Numeric extremes: � � � are dropped, 😀 is kept as an emoji.

Filler so the article is comfortably longer than the minimum: the bakery sells sourdough, rye, and seeded loaves, and the owner says the cinnamon rolls sell out before noon on weekends.
